extName.description: Extension name in Chrome and in the store.

extDescription.message: Collapse tabs into groups in one click and free up memory. Groups as tiles, a watch-later video queue. Everything in sight.

cmdStowCurrent.message: Stow the current group or tab in TabFlow

cmdSleepCurrent.message: Put the current group to sleep

cmdQueueCurrent.message: Add the current tab to the watch-later queue

cmdOpenQueue.message: Open the queue in the side panel
